architecture.summary: Documents only. SO-11 adds docs/implementation/tenant-fleet-runbooks.md: runbooks for a failed provision, an orphaned Render service, a paused Supabase project, and the deletion of a tenant; the rotations of the Render API keys, the gateway key pair, LOGGING_DESTINATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY, and the GitHub token of ghcr-thermus-hosted-read; the monthly GHCR pruning; the shared Brave search limit; and the alerts. Each step that waits for SO-05, SO-09, or SO-10 has a marker. No source, test, configuration, workflow, or migration changes, so no component, edge, public module, declaration, or runtime behavior changes. README, the docs index, and the plan link the document, and the README pruning rule also keeps the TENANT_IMAGE digest. The registry gains one prose paragraph in the deployment view; no Mermaid block changes.
